dataset_rule: all Sol replicates executed under the protocol are pooled; execution batches are provenance only
denominator_rule: rates use attempted runs minus technical (API/infrastructure) failures; model-output-invalid runs stay in the denominator

final_decision_correct_definition.naive_direct_llm: CRB level-3 endpoint: selected candidate within the predeclared 7.5 pp modifier-plane L1 near region of the held-out composition (post-freeze scoring)
final_decision_correct_definition.rges: frozen RGES adjudication rule: committed selection whose intervention family (dual-axis resin-modified) AND measurement plan (M-HOLD-120) both match the completed experiment
final_decision_correct_definition.cbes_A: committed, chemistry-admissible (no domain violation, no unsupported shortcut) selection of the direct thermal-hold measurement M-HOLD-120
final_decision_correct_definition.cbes_B: committed, chemistry-admissible (no domain violation, no unsupported shortcut) selection of the direct temperature sweep M-SWEEP

rges_voi_withheld.role: rule-layer ablation: deterministic VOI score withheld

cbes_A_drift_V5_NO_GATE.role: architecture ablation: chemistry gate advice-only (thermal-hold condition)

cbes_A_drift_V5_FULL.role: Full PUR Agent with enforced chemistry gate (thermal-hold condition)

cbes_B_processing_window_V5_NO_GATE.role: architecture ablation: chemistry gate advice-only (processing-window condition)

cbes_B_processing_window_V5_FULL.role: Full PUR Agent with enforced chemistry gate (processing-window condition)
